title: Cowork Adoption Intelligence
subtitle: Reach, consistency, organizational patterns, maturity, champions, work mix, and transparent assisted-time scenarios.
text: Meet Cowork Adoption Intelligence: a testing, data-free Power BI template that turns approved Cowork exports into a clear adoption story. It connects reach, return, organizational patterns, workflow maturity, potential champions, work mix, and modeled assisted time.

title: Start Here
subtitle: Ten pages, clear questions, and a traceable evidence path
caption: Begin with the decision, then follow the right evidence.
text: Start Here routes program owners to the right question. Is adoption building momentum? Where is it strongest? How mature is usage? Begin with the decision, then open the page that carries the right evidence and interpretation boundary.

eyebrow: LATEST ACTIVE WEEK | ADOPTION AT A GLANCE
title: Executive Summary
subtitle: Reach, recurrence, intensity, and delegation maturity
caption: Read the momentum score together with its four components.
text: Executive Summary reads the latest active week. Weekly active users show reach. Prompts, return rate, and active days show habit. The momentum score balances return, consistency, intensity, and advanced delegation, so share it with the week, filters, weights, and caps.

title: Weekly Adoption & Usage
subtitle: Twelve active weeks of reach, consistency, and concentration
caption: Compare the same period and population before calling a trend.
text: Weekly Adoption and Usage shows the latest twelve active weeks. Switch among reach, momentum, prompts, active days, and return rate without clearing filters. Use the heatmap to find concentration, then check rollout timing, holidays, and export coverage before calling a trend.

title: Adoption by Attributes
subtitle: Task volume and delegation patterns by available organization fields
caption: Missing organization enrichment means unavailable breakdowns - not zero activity.
text: Adoption by Attributes compares observed task volume and delegation patterns by department or country. These views depend on optional organization enrichment. Always check population size and mapping coverage before comparing groups.

title: User Maturity
subtitle: Usage consistency, skill chaining, and delegation depth
caption: Maturity signals workflow depth - not unattended work or performance.
text: User Maturity combines the delegation ladder, multi-skill task share, task duration, and rolling twelve-week usage tiers. Scheduled-task totals are lifetime-scoped, while the other rungs follow the selected period. Pair every maturity signal with role and work context.

eyebrow: CHAMPIONS | ENABLEMENT EVIDENCE, NOT A RATING
title: Cowork Champions
subtitle: Consistent category engagement and department coverage
caption: Confirm role fit, willingness, manager support, and appropriate data use.
text: Cowork Champions identifies potential enablement partners, not top performers. Eligibility requires three observed threads across two active weeks. The evidence score balances activity, consistency, and delegation maturity, then applies the selected percentile tier.

title: Activity & Assisted Hours
subtitle: Observed activity plus adjustable time-saved assumptions
caption: Modeled assistance is scenario planning - not audited savings.
text: Activity and Assisted Hours connects observed Cowork records to low, mid, or high time-saved assumptions. Category results are allocated estimates, not per-skill metering or a time study. Present a range and label every result as modeled assisted time.

title: What They Use It For
subtitle: Observed skills, work categories, taxonomy coverage, and detail
caption: The goal is better workflow enablement - not simply more prompts.
text: What They Use It For groups observed skills into work patterns and preserves action and user detail behind bookmarks. Action value tiers are declared category references, not user scores. Review unmapped skills and validate dominant categories before recommending a workflow.

eyebrow: SCORE GUIDE | DIRECTION, NOT A GRADE
title: Momentum Score Guide
subtitle: Live components, optional weights, caps, and guardrails
caption: Keep settings stable over time and never compare customized scores across organizations.
text: Momentum Score Guide explains the live adoption signal before exposing optional controls. The default weights are thirty-five percent return, twenty-five percent consistency, twenty-five percent intensity, and fifteen percent maturity. If the weights do not total one hundred percent, the score becomes blank.

title: Adoption Metric Guide
subtitle: Definitions, thresholds, dependencies, and safe interpretation
caption: Optional-source absence means unavailable data - not zero activity.
text: The Adoption Metric Guide defines all ten report pages, with evidence status, thresholds, dependencies, and interpretation boundaries. Copy the definition, reporting period, filters, and status into decision records. This is decision support, not billing, compliance, or personnel evidence.

title: One report. A clearer adoption story.
subtitle: Try the fabricated sample, review the interpretation guide, and connect approved exports when ready.
text: That is Cowork Adoption Intelligence: one testing template for reach, return, organizational patterns, workflow maturity, champions, work mix, and transparent assisted-time scenarios. Start with the fabricated sample, review the definitions, then connect approved exports when ready.
